item.title: Court orders Instagram and Facebook's Meta to pay $567M to address kids' mental health online

item.title: SpaceX's revenue rises as its once-soaring stock price drifts back to Earth
item.description: On their first earnings call since SpaceX's June public offering, executives said the company is pouring funds into rocket development, Starlink satellites and AI.

item.title: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?

item.title: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
item.description: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

item.title: Elon Musk's AI company is suing to block a new Minnesota law against certain AI apps
item.description: Minnesota has a new law taking effect Saturday to ban AI apps that allow for "nudification." Elon Musk's AI company is suing to block it, saying it violates free speech, noting that it can be used for satire of prominent people.

item.title: Digital habits that rob attention and energy — and how to combat them
item.description: There's a reason why double- or triple-screening your devices makes you feel tired, says NPR's Manoush Zomorodi. She explains the science of information overload and how to reclaim calm and focus.
